description_en: Calls GetMPUTaskStatus to query the status of a stream relay task
description_zh: 调用GetMPUTaskStatus获取旁路转推任务状态
kebab_example: aliyun rtc get-mpu-task-status --app-id yourAppId --task-id yourTaskId --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMPUTaskStatus

parameters.description_en: The application ID. Only a single ID is supported.
parameters.help_en: The application ID. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The task ID. Only a single ID is supported. The value must be the same as the TaskId parameter of [StartMpuTask](~~93183~~).
parameters.description_zh: 任务ID，仅支持传单个ID，和[StartMpuTask](~~93183~~)入参TaskId一致。
parameters.help_en: The task ID. Only a single ID is supported. The value must be the same as the TaskId parameter of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93183.html
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，仅支持传单个ID，和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93183.html入参TaskId一致
parameters.name: task_id
